verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud's pricing page lists "AI Automatically Syncs Emails, Events, and Contacts," a first-party email-sync capability, but it is only a one-line feature bullet with no detail. Missing for 10: documented Gmail and Outlook connectors, confirmation that sync is two-way, evidence of automatic logging and matching to the correct records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records

citations.quote: AI Automatically Syncs Emails, Events, and Contacts
